race.comment: MAKE ME GREAT (4) has trialled up impressively around his only start to date at the Sunshine Coast. He has a good draw, and can show his true ability here. INTERACTIVE (2) has changed stables since his last run nearly 8 weeks ago. He has had a few gear changes, and any market support would be worth following in this modest lineup. CHOCECLAIR (15) is yet to break through from 12 starts, but is rarely far away and has drawn to be right up there. LUMINOUS GIRL (14) falls into a similar boat, but has shown glimpses and appears the next in line in her return.
